hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the front-end pod will cause the front-end service to be unavailable, breaking all golden journey steps.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: front-end, catalogue, login, and orders steps return HTTP 200/201
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/front-end, observe front-end service responses, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod restarts and service recovers after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the catalogue pod will cause the catalogue browse step to fail, but other steps may still succeed.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/catalogue, observe catalogue endpoint, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod restarts and catalogue service recovers after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the user pod will cause the login step to fail, as authentication depends on the user service.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: login step returns HTTP 200 and sets cookie
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/user, observe login endpoint, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod restarts and user service recovers after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the orders pod will cause the orders step to fail, as it depends on the orders service.
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on workload/orders, observe orders endpoint, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Pod restarts and orders service recovers after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing network delay on the front-end service will cause timeouts and degrade all golden journey steps.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: all steps return HTTP 200/201 within timeout
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/front-end, observe all steps, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Delay removed and service returns to normal after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing network delay on the catalogue service will cause the catalogue browse step to be slow or fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: catalogue step returns JSON array within timeout
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/catalogue, observe catalogue endpoint, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Delay removed and catalogue service returns to normal after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing network delay on the user service will cause the login step to be slow or fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: login step returns HTTP 200 and sets cookie within timeout
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/user, observe login endpoint, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Delay removed and user service returns to normal after washout.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing network delay on the orders service will cause the orders step to be slow or fail.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: orders step returns HTTP 201 within timeout
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/orders, observe orders endpoint, then recover.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Delay removed and orders service returns to normal after washout.
